name: Improved Seeker Arrow
body:
Your foes can run but they can’t hide. Even well hidden opponents cannot escape your devilish arrows, who would follow your foes to the ends of the earth.

Prerequisite(s): 6th-level arcane archer

Benefit: With this feat, you are able to use your Seeker Arrow ability twice more per day.
